sources.prompt: Create an original production sprite atlas for a fantasy strategy game's terrain. Transparent background. A regular 3 columns x 2 rows grid, six isolated whole tree sprites, one tree perfectly centered in each equal rectangular cell, generous clear padding around each, no overlap, no grid lines or labels. Top row: three different mature broadleaf oaks with compact irregular rounded lobed canopies, dark deep forest green interior, many small distinct leaf clusters picked out by golden yellow-green sun on the upper left, visible branching brown trunks and small roots. One narrow oak, one spreading oak, one asymmetrical oak. Bottom row: three distinct slender evergreen conifers, natural tiered pointed fir/pine silhouettes with spiky foliage branches, dark green interior and golden lime upper-left sun accents, visible trunks, medium, tall and slightly bent variants. All six trees seen at the SAME elevated three-quarter strategy game angle, looking slightly down, like a hand painted Civilization fantasy game terrain asset. High detail, warm luminous afternoon lighting from upper left, convincing organic varied forms, fine painterly brush marks and tiny crisp highlighted leaves, rich dark greens, mossy bark. More realistic painterly miniature than low resolution pixel art, no cartoon black outlines, no plastic smooth balls, no cinematic backdrop. Each tree fills about 80 percent of its own cell's height and 65 percent width. Absolutely NO ground planes, NO surrounding grass, NO cast shadows, NO forest scenery, NO text. Only six tree cutout assets on transparent canvas.

Original production diffuse/albedo texture for fantasy strategy game terrain, top-down orthographic seamless grassland turf texture, square image filled edge to edge with ground, NO horizon, NO perspective, NO objects. Fine richly detailed hand-painted natural meadow sward at miniature scale. Dense tiny short olive-green and yellow-green blades lying in diverse directions, tiny muted pale cream wildflower flecks very sparsely scattered, darker moss and earthy brown between irregular tiny tufts, a subtle few weathered tiny grey pebbles. Irregular broad softly merging patches of golden olive and deep moss green, approximately 70 percent medium yellow-olive greens, 20 percent dark desaturated green shadow, 10 percent warm dry ochre blades. Very fine varied leaf texture, realistic painterly style of premium fantasy civilization game terrain, coherent warm daylight, no baked strong directional shadows. It must read as a natural carpet from high above, not large plants. No repeating horizontal rows, no stripes, no tiling grid, no large flowers, no tall grass clumps, no black outline, no water. Texture approximately 4 meters across, hundreds of small ground details. Colors medium value olive, restrained golden highlights, detailed but not bright neon or oversaturated. Seamless tile at all edges.

No soil, NO ground patches, NO rocks, NO surrounding scenery, NO shadows, NO background, NO text or labels. Six isolated objects, precisely one per grid cell, three grasses on top and three flowers below.
